title: Thermodynamic Formalism for Quasimorphisms: Lattices in Higher Rank Semisimple Lie Groups
summary: We give a new proof, based on thermodynamic formalism, of a foundational result of Burger and Monod in bounded cohomology. Let $G$ be a noncompact connected semisimple real Lie group with finite center and no factors of real rank one, and let $Γ<G$ be a uniform lattice. We prove that, for every orthogonal representation $π:Γ\to\operatorname{O}_N$, every $π$-quasimorphism $L:Γ\to\mathbb{R}^N$ is bounded.
